method.description: Two git worktrees sharing substantial content indexed through the global embedding cache. Cache hit ratio, bytes saved, and bit-equivalence measured via unit tests simulating the cross-project dedup scenario.
method.model_digest_namespace: blake3 of ONNX model bytes (test fixture)
method.cache_key: CacheKey 6-tuple: (model_digest, tokenizer_digest, prompt_role_and_version, pooling, normalization, output_dimensions, content_hash)

two_worktree_full_overlap.scenario: Two worktrees with 100% shared content (10 identical source texts)
two_worktree_full_overlap.quality: bit-equivalent (cache hits return identical f32 bits to stored vectors)

two_worktree_partial_overlap.scenario: Two worktrees with 80% shared content (8 shared + 2 unique per worktree)

cross_project_dedup.assertion: zero duplicate ONNX inference calls for shared content

byte_accounting.description: Every cache entry tracked by byte size. Total bytes = sum of row file sizes (ROW_HEADER_LEN + dim * sizeof(f32) per row).
byte_accounting.entry_size_rejection: Entries exceeding max_entry_bytes are rejected and counted in telemetry
byte_accounting.byte_budget_eviction: LRU eviction of unreferenced rows when total exceeds max_bytes

telemetry.persisted: Counters persisted to telemetry.json across restarts

crash_isolation.assertion: VAL-CACHE-013: Worker crash mid-batch leaves cache consistent. Atomic staging+rename ensures no partial rows visible. Retry is idempotent via content_hash.
crash_isolation.partial_recovery: Staging .partial files are never visible as cache rows
crash_isolation.idempotent_retry: Same content_hash after retry produces no duplicate row

gpu_policy.assertion: VAL-CACHE-011: Worker idle does not consume GPU. No polling loop between batches. GPU work occurs only during ONNX inference dispatch.

privacy.assertion: VAL-CACHE-015: No source text stored after hashing.

conclusions.cross_project_savings: 100% hit ratio for identical content across worktrees — zero duplicate ONNX inference
